input_overrides.value: Microsoft paid $196.00 a share in cash for LinkedIn, a 49.5% premium to the 2016-06-10 close of $131.08 and a $26.2bn enterprise value, financed primarily with new debt; the merger closed on 2016-12-08. The price rests on management's Forecasts, which grow revenue from $2,991mm in 2015 to $7,365mm in 2020 and levered free cash flow from $458mm to $2,107mm: at Qatalyst's 10.0%-13.0% discount rates, the case is whether those cash flows arrive, not the bridge.
input_overrides.source: LinkedIn definitive merger proxy statement (DEFM14A), filed 2016-07-22
